text: The next day. <break time="0.8s" /> Giovanni called on Professor Pietro Baglioni. <break time="0.8s" /> An old friend of his father. <break time="0.8s" /> Who received him warmly. <break time="0.8s" /> And spoke with a cheerful ease. <break time="0.8s" /> That softened his learned dignity. <break time="0.8s" /> When Giovanni mentioned Rappaccini. <break time="0.8s" /> The professor admitted that Rappaccini was as skillful as any doctor in Italy. <break time="0.8s" /> But warned that he cared infinitely more for science. <break time="0.8s" /> Than for mankind. <break time="0.8s" /> His patients interest him. <break time="0.8s" /> Only as subjects for some new experiment. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Baglioni. <break time="0.8s" /> And he would sacrifice human life. <break time="0.8s" /> His own among the rest. <break time="0.8s" /> To add a grain of mustard seed. <break time="0.8s" /> To his knowledge. <break time="0.8s" /> Baglioni whose long rivalry with Rappaccini was well known. <break time="0.8s" /> Added that the daughter was rumored to be so learned. <break time="0.8s" /> That she might already fill a professors chair. <break time="0.8s" /> At the university. <break time="0.8s" /> That evening, from his window. <break time="0.8s" /> Giovanni watched Beatrice pluck one of the purple flowers. <break time="0.8s" /> And a drop of moisture. <break time="0.8s" /> From its broken stem. <break time="0.8s" /> Fell upon a small lizard. <break time="0.8s" /> Creeping at her feet. <break time="0.8s" /> The creature twisted for a moment. <break time="0.8s" /> And then lay motionless in the sunshine. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon a bright insect. <break time="0.8s" /> Hovering near her face. <break time="0.8s" /> Drooped and fell lifeless at her feet. <break time="0.8s" /> As if poisoned by her breath. <break time="0.8s" /> Hardly knowing what he did Giovanni threw down a fresh bouquet. <break time="0.8s" /> He had bought that day. <break time="0.8s" /> And Beatrice. <break time="0.8s" /> Smiling with a mixture of childish and womanly delight. <break time="0.8s" /> Picked it up. <break time="0.8s" /> As she turned back toward the house. <break time="0.8s" /> Giovanni fancied that the flowers were already beginning to wither. <break time="0.8s" /> In her grasp. <break time="0.8s" /> Though at such a distance. <break time="0.8s" /> He could hardly be sure of it.
